goal.request: Evaluate whether the applied phase-transition visual semantics and candidate-pack data survive one independently authored, reference-guided, randomized complex render.

evidence.claim: The supplied portrait visibly supports only bounded adult appearance cues, and the precommitted rubric requires one specimen, one gradient, parent material, multiple nuclei, and a continuous interface.
Candidate-pack v6 generated one request-scoped phase_transition_nucleation_growth obligation and both composed and runtime audits passed with no failures.
The audited final prompt literally binds the five required evidence fields while preserving all five authorial-core anchors.
The built-in image generator returned one saved image from exactly one attached-reference call and no retry.
Thumbnail and native review passed all five official visual-obligation gates and all five coordinator gates in the same saved image.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: One complete ampoule simultaneously reads as a bounded specimen under a cold-to-warm gradient, with amber parent fluid, multiple pale solid nuclei, and a continuous advancing frost interface.

invariants.statement: Every phase region and the advancing interface remain inside one readable specimen boundary.
The new phase and interface align with a coherent physical cold-to-warm driver rather than a color-light effect.
The generated adult retains only the reference's observable hair, eye, eyebrow, and broad facial-proportion cues without an identity claim.

hypotheses.statement: If all five profile evidence bindings remain literal and the ampoule shares one focal plane with the subject, the generator can preserve the complete nucleation-growth relation in a complex single frame.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any official pixel gate fails or becomes ambiguous in the single delivered image.

intervention.general_rule: This arm evaluated the already-applied request-scoped profile and candidate data without modifying runtime sources.
intervention.generalization_basis: The profile expresses a case-independent same-specimen, driver, parent, nuclei, and interface mechanism.

decision.rationale: This one randomized arm is a full technical pixel PASS, but it remains a motivating case without an unrelated held-out render inside this arm and without requesting-user judgment; no universal promotion claim is made.
